description: Historical measurements from an official SwissMetNet station over a date range (recent weeks), delivered via the api.existenz.ch proxy. Station codes are 3-letter MeteoSwiss codes, e.g. 'SMA' Zürich-Fluntern, 'BER' Bern, 'GVE' Geneva; see get_current_measurements station IDs. Long ranges are downsampled: precipitation and sunshine are summed per bucket (totals preserved), other parameters averaged with min/max.
name: get_weather_history
title: Historical weather measurements
